item.title: Bauchi, Gombe get new AIG amid growing insecurity
item.description: The Zone 12 Police Headquarters, Bauchi has announced the assumption of duty of Assistant Inspector-General of Police, AIG Vungmoh S.M Kwaimo, as the 31st Assistant Inspector-General of the Zone; comprising Bauchi/Gombe. item.title: AFCON top scorers ahead of quarter-final fixtures [Full list]
item.description: Morocco star, Brahim Diaz is the current top scorer at the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations, AFCON. item.description: Grief has continued to envelop the Omatu family following the death of three brothers who were among the eight victims of the devastating fire that engulfed the Great Nigeria Insurance, GNI, building on Martins Street, Lagos Island, on December 24, 2025. item.title: Venezuela agreed to transfer 50 million barrels of crude oil to US – Trump
item.description: United States President Donald Trump has announced that Venezuela’s interim government has consented to transfer between 30 and 50 million barrels of premium crude oil to the United States. Trump revealed this development on Wednesday through his Truth Social account. The oil currently classified as sanctioned—would be sold at prevailing international market prices. item.title: Niger frees former oil minister nearly one year in detention
item.description: Niger’s former Minister of Petroleum, Mahaman Moustapha Barke, has been released from detention almost a year after he was arrested by the country’s military authorities, according to members of his family and a close associate.
